description: Search the public Soundcheck live-event gear taxonomy (microphones, DI boxes, consoles, lighting, video, rigging, movers, cables, stands, backline, wireless, etc.). Optional query filters by name, alias, id, or category. Returns catalog version + types with stable inventory ids — not org stock levels, serials, quantities, or pricing. normalize_inventory maps free-text gear lists onto these ids.

query.description: optional search string (e.g. SM58, DI, mover, XLR). Absent or empty lists the full public catalog.

name: search_inventory

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Search inventory types
